annotation.interpretation_a: Interpretation 1: ignore the unknown or unsupported values but continue processing the rest of the extensible protocol element.
annotation.interpretation_b: Interpretation 2: ignore the entire extensible protocol element if it contains any unknown or unsupported values.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify what to do with the rest of the element when unknown values are present, leading to two materially different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: Definition of 'extensible protocol elements' and explicit guidance on how to handle unknown values within them (e.g., whether to discard the entire element or just the unknown values).
